english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Advent of Five Fathers from the Five Limbs of the Father
english_classification.chapter_note: Very short, remarkably clean chapter. The oldest teaching layer dominates — a compact five-fold emanation-to-faculty mapping (P2) plus a process summary (P3), wrapped in a thin dialogue frame (P1). No editorial bridge, no institutional content, no exhortation. The substrate shift score (+17.19 in second half) reflects the teaching content concentrated in P2-P3. The five emanation figures (Ambassador, Beloved of the Lights, Mother of Life, Jesus the Beloved, Virgin of Light) are mapped to the Father's five limbs (mind, thought, insight, counsel, consideration) — a classic Persian-tradition correspondential enumeration.
